_readme: TMP_009 iteration 4 spike — Phase A.v2 after iter 3 (Illustrious + 2 LoRA) collapsed to anime faces + bokeh noise. Swaps base to `terrain-realisticfantasy-v30` (SDXL realistic-fantasy mix, not anime-prior). Drops the character-art `NewFantasyCoreV4_ILL` LoRA (smoking gun in iter 3). Keeps only `isty03_style @ 0.6` for isometric composition. One-LoRA-only stack so the sub-agent measurement isolates base model behaviour cleanly. Same fixture as iter 3. Same hardened anti-ground negative.
